test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that does NOT have a spelling error.

options.text: A variety of languages are spoken in India.
A veriety of languages are spoken in India.
A vareity of languages are spoken in India.
A varity of languages are spoken in India.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"variety"** means a number or collection of different things or people. (विविधता)

 
 
• **Example: **The market offers a** variety **of fruits and vegetables.
 
 
 
• **"Variety"** is correctly spelled and used in the context of the sentence. (विविधता)
 
 
• **Example: **There is a** variety **of books available in the library.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: A veriety of languages are spoken in India. **(वेराइटी): The word "veriety" is a misspelling of "variety."

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: A veriety of languages are spoken in India. Correct: A variety of languages are spoken in India.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: A vareity of languages are spoken in India. **(वरेइटी): The word "vareity" is a misspelling of "variety."
 
 
• **Example: **Incorrect: A vareity of languages are spoken in India. Correct: A variety of languages are spoken in India.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: A varity of languages are spoken in India. **(वरिटी): The word "varity" is a misspelling of "variety."
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: A varity of languages are spoken in India. Correct: A variety of languages are spoken in India.
